operators.name: custom_adaptive_avg_pool1d
semantics: Input is a 3D tensor, output is a 3D tensor with last dimension equal to output_size.
For each (batch, channel), output[i] = average of input over window determined by adaptive pooling formula.
Supports arbitrary strides; kernel should index accordingly or make contiguous copy if needed.
Returns a newly allocated contiguous tensor with the same dtype and device as input.
Applies AdaptiveAvgPool1d(output_size=64) to x with shape [128, 128, 24576].
Output shape becomes [128, 128, 64], dtype float32, device cuda:0.
Returns the pooled tensor of shape [128, 128, 64].
